svg.title: Create a cloud browser, then drive it over CDP
svg.desc: Step 1: your code calls POST /api/v4/browsers on the Browser Use API and gets back 201 with an id, a cdpUrl and a liveUrl. Step 2: Playwright or Puppeteer connects to the cdpUrl over a CDP WebSocket; commands such as Page.navigate go to the cloud browser and events such as Page.loadEventFired come back. Step 3: the cloud browser, a stealth Chrome with a proxy and a live view, loads the web page. Step 4: stop it with PATCH /api/v4/browsers/{id} and action stop. Closing the CDP connection leaves the browser running.
svg.text: closing the CDP connection leaves the
browser running; stop it with step 4
